summary.text: Furquan Stafford is the Republican candidate for the Georgia State Senate, District 10, in the November 3, 2026 general election, against Democrat Larry Johnson in a race with no incumbent.
According to Ballotpedia, Stafford has worked as an entrepreneur and medical researcher, and he was the Republican candidate for the same seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Furquan Stafford was born in Newark, New Jersey, and earned an associate degree from McCook Community College in 1994.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as working as an entrepreneur and medical researcher.
Stafford was the Republican candidate for Georgia State Senate District 10 in 2024, when incumbent Democrat Emanuel Jones defeated him in the general election, 85.3% to 14.7%.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, Stafford said his platform included tax reduction and regulatory simplification, support for schools and educators, support for law enforcement and community policing, and patient-centered healthcare reforms.
